# Lawang Estate

> Curated tropical real estate in Bali and Sumba, Indonesia. Hand-picked villas, land and signature estates for international buyers and investors. The website is served in English, Spanish and Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia).

## Key facts
- Focus: curated tropical properties in Bali and Sumba, Indonesia
- Offering: villas, land plots and signature estate listings
- Audience: international buyers and investors
- Website: https://lawangproperties.com
- Legal entity: PT TEPI SUN GAI, Denpasar, Bali, Indonesia
- Tenure offered: Freehold HGB (Hak Guna Bangunan) held through a PT PMA company, and
  leasehold on selected units. NOT Hak Milik — that title is reserved to Indonesian
  citizens and cannot be transferred to a foreign buyer.

## Languages
The site is available in three languages. The page content itself is the same; the
language is chosen in the header selector and can be linked directly with `?lang=`:
- English (default): https://lawangproperties.com/
- Spanish: https://lawangproperties.com/?lang=es
- Indonesian (Bahasa): https://lawangproperties.com/?lang=id

Note for crawlers that do not execute JavaScript: the HTML served at these URLs is the
English source. The Spanish and Indonesian text is applied in the browser, so only the
English wording is visible to a non-JS fetch. There are no separate per-language URLs.

## Sections
- [Portfolio](https://lawangproperties.com/thecollection): the full collection of available properties.
- [Signature](https://lawangproperties.com/thecollection#signature): the flagship / primary estate listings.
- [Palm Field](https://lawangproperties.com/palmfield): private pool villas in Balian Hills, with a step-by-step price estimator.
- [Villa models](https://lawangproperties.com/modelo/dali): the five villa models, their specifications and prices.

## Legal
- [Privacy & terms, English](https://lawangproperties.com/legal)
- [Privacy & terms, Spanish](https://lawangproperties.com/legal-es)
- [Accessibility statement](https://lawangproperties.com/accessibility)
There is no Indonesian version of the legal pages. Under UU 24/2009 an Indonesian-language
version of a legal document governs, so it is drafted by counsel rather than translated.
